title: Who owns risk when tail scenarios tie?
prompt: Losses are positive for losses and negative for gains. VaR at alpha is inf{x: P(loss<=x)>=alpha}; ES is the mean of the worst 1-alpha probability mass, taking only the necessary fraction of any boundary atom. DeskA and deskB losses add within each scenario. Attribute80% portfolio ES using the portfolio tail, not standalone desk tails. At a tied total-loss boundary, select probability mass proportionally across all tied scenarios. Report total ES, allocations[A,B], and the unconditional mass selected from the total-loss10 tie group.

inputs.tie_rule: proportional scenario probability within equal-total-loss group

outputs.name: attributions
outputs.description: Conditional tail losses[A,B] under proportional tie rule.

outputs.name: selected_tie_mass
outputs.description: Unconditional mass selected from total loss10.
